## What I did

Using the output from the describe cluster RCT method, I ran a set of simulations where, for each outcome, I did the following:

  1) Generate fake dataset in line with describe cluster RCT.  This dataset has no treatment variation at all.
  2) Estimate impacts on the fake dataset
  3) Calculate the range of ATE estimates and the ratio of the largest to smallest SE estimate for each outcome for that run.
  
We can then make a series of dot charts, with each dot chart being the set of ranges we found across the outcomes.
We insert the true empirical data ranges in a random facet of this set of charts.


At the moment we are looking at no covariate adjustment for everything.


## The ATE ranges and SE ratios

```{r, include=FALSE}

# Pick 14 sim data
set.seed( 4044404 )

n_sim = 16
selected_sims = sample( setdiff( unique( simdat$runID ), "real" ), n_sim-1 )
selected_sims

sub_dat <- simdat %>% 
  filter( runID %in% c( selected_sims, "real" ) )


# Make hidden IDs
sub_dat$blindRunID = factor( sub_dat$runID,
                             levels = sample( unique(sub_dat$runID) ),
                             labels = 1:n_sim )


# Which is the real one??
sub_dat %>% 
  dplyr::select( runID, blindRunID ) %>%
  distinct() 

table( sub_dat$Estimand )
sub_dat <- sub_dat %>%
  filter( Estimand == "overall" )
```


```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width = 9, out.width="100%"}
aterange_plot <- ggplot( sub_dat, aes( rangeATE ) ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ blindRunID, nrow=4 ) +
  geom_dotplot( method="histodot" ) +
  labs( title = "5 replicates of fingerprint for ATE ranges",
        subtitle = "(true data also present)" ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
aterange_plot
ggsave( here::here( "fingerprint_ATE_ranges.pdf" ), width = 8, height = 4 ) 

```

```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width = 9, out.width="100%"}
seratio_plot <- ggplot( sub_dat, aes( ratioSE ) ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ blindRunID ) +
  geom_dotplot( method="histodot" ) +
  labs( title = "5 replicates of fingerprint for SE ratio",
        subtitle = "(Ratios windsorized at 5x; true data also present)" ) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
   theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

seratio_plot
```
